parameters.help_en: The list of zone IDs. You can query up to 20 zone IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID列表。一次最多支持查询20个可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of virtual private cloud (VPC) IDs. You can query up to 20 VPC IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID列表。一次最多支持查询20个VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_ids

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid value:

Ipv4: IPv4
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

Ipv4：Ipv4类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The status of the GWLB instance. Valid values:

Active: The instance is running.

Inactive: The instance is stopped. In this state, the listener of the instance does not forward traffic.

Provisioning: The instance is being created.

Configuring: The instance is being modified
parameters.help_zh:
网关型负载均衡的实例状态。取值：
Active：运行中。
Inactive：已停止，表示实例监听不会再转发流量。
Provisioning：创建中。
Configuring：变配中
parameters.name: load_balancer_status

parameters.help_en:
The business status of the GWLB instance. Valid values:

Normal: The instance is running as expected.

FinancialLocked: The instance is locked due to an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
网关型负载均衡的业务状态。取值：
Normal：正常状态。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定状态
parameters.name: load_balancer_business_status

parameters.help_en: The list of GWLB instance names. You can query up to 20 instance names at a time
parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例名称列表。一次最多支持查询20个实例名称
parameters.name: load_balancer_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of GWLB instance IDs. You can query up to 20 instance IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID列表。一次最多支持查询20个实例
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en:
The traffic mode. Valid values:

LoadBalance: The instance is in load balancing mode.

ByPass: The instance is in bypass mode
parameters.help_zh:
流量模式。取值：

LoadBalance：负载均衡。
ByPass：绕行模式
parameters.name: traffic_mode

fields.help_en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签健最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, it indicates that no next query is to be sent.

If NextToken has a value, the value is the token that is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip
parameters.help_zh: 查询时跳过指定的条目数
parameters.name: skip

Key.description_en:

Value.description_en:
The tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
